description: This is a rectangular rug with a geometric pattern. The pattern consists of interlocking triangles in varying shades of grey, white, and mustard yellow. The triangles are arranged in a tessellating fashion, creating a dynamic and modern visual effect. The rug appears to be made of a soft textile material, suitable for adding comfort and style to a floor. The edges of the rug are finished with a clean, serged border. The overall design is contemporary and abstract, offering a bold statement piece for a room.
